info.title: Splat API
info.description: Turn photos and videos into interactive 3D Gaussian Splat scenes.

timestamp.description: When the event was made, UTC with milliseconds. Retries carry the same value.

viewer_url.description: The scene's viewer page on the web app.

psnr.description: PSNR on the training views, in dB.

training_time_seconds.description: Seconds the training stage took, not the whole job.

data.description: A metric the pipeline did not report, or reported as zero, is null.

timestamp.description: When the event was made, UTC with milliseconds. Retries carry the same value.

upload_url.description: Presigned URL: `PUT` the source file here, then call `/process`.

sceneId.description: Same as `scene_id`. Kept for older clients.

uploadUrl.description: Same as `upload_url`. Kept for older clients.

code.description: Machine-readable error code. One of: `invalid_input`, `source_missing`, `unauthorized`, `insufficient_credits`, `forbidden`, `not_found`, `conflict`, `retry_blocked`, `payload_too_large`, `source_unusable`, `quota_exceeded`, `queue_full`, `internal_error`, `upstream_error`, `service_unavailable`. More may be added, so treat an unknown code by its HTTP status.

details.description: Structured detail, absent on most errors. A request that fails validation (400 `invalid_input`) lists one `{field, message}` per problem. A parameter outside the tier's range (422) lists `{field, value, allowed, tier, hint}`; `source_unusable` names the rule that failed.

example.hint: iterations=15000 requires the quality tier or higher.

period.description: `quota_exceeded`: the month whose quota is used up.

limit.description: `quota_exceeded`: the monthly limit. `queue_full`: how many scenes may process at once.

current.description: `queue_full`: how many of your scenes are processing now.

training_tier.description: Legacy alias of `preset`, read only when `preset` is absent. `pro` and `hd` mean `quality`.

enable_lod.description: Checked against the tier, not kept. Send `enable_lod` in the `/process` body to get level-of-detail chunks.

webhook_url.description: https URL to receive a webhook when scene processing completes or fails.

webhook_secret.description: Secret for HMAC-SHA256 webhook signature verification.

status.description: The stored status, the same on every call. `uploading`, then the pipeline stages (`extracting_frames`, `estimating_poses`, `training`, `exporting`, `compressing`; older scenes may show `running_sfm` or a retired `preview_extracting`, `preview_generating` or `preview_compressing`), then `complete`, `failed` or `cancelled`. More stages may be added.

thumbnail_url.description: `GET /v1/scenes/{id}/thumbnail` when the scene has a thumbnail. A private scene's needs its owner's API key.

psnr_holdout.description: Holdout PSNR — populated when complete if images were held out (`output.holdout_ratio` above 0; every preset but `fast` by default).

ssim_holdout.description: Holdout SSIM — populated when complete if images were held out (`output.holdout_ratio` above 0; every preset but `fast` by default).

processing_stage.description: Current pipeline stage while processing; null otherwise, including once complete.

processing_pct.description: 0-100 progress while processing; null otherwise, including once complete.

processing_error.description: Error message if processing failed or was cancelled.

viewer_url.description: Shareable viewer page on the web app — populated when complete.

download_url.description: Download URL for the output model — populated when complete.

format.description: Output format: sog (compressed) or ply — populated when complete.

lod_meta_url.description: LOD metadata URL — populated when complete with LOD enabled.

next_cursor.description: Opaque. Pass it back unchanged as `cursor` for the next page. Null on the last page.

status.description: Always `processing`: the launch was accepted. Poll `GET /v1/scenes/{id}` for the stored status.

sceneId.description: Same as `scene_id`. Kept for older clients.

file_path.description: Path of the image in the uploaded zip; the file name alone works when it is unique

transform.description: 4x4 camera-to-world matrix, column-major (ARKit simd_float4x4 layout), in a gravity-aligned world with +Y up (ARKit worldAlignment .gravity or .gravityAndHeading). Scene orientation is taken from it.

arkit_poses.description: Camera poses from an ARKit session. They don't skip SfM: GLOMAP still solves the camera poses from the images. The poses set the scene's up direction from ARKit gravity (at least 30 frames or photos must pair with a pose) and, for a video, which frames are extracted: up to 150, at the pose timestamps.

lidar_points.description: LiDAR point cloud from ARKit ARMeshAnchor. Each entry is [x, y, z] or [x, y, z, r, g, b]. Max 50K points.

id.description: The new scene, a version of the source. Poll it.

source_scene_id.description: The scene retrained, left as it was.

quality_tier.description: The tier the new scene runs at, in pricing's names.
The tier to run at, in pricing's names (`pro` runs the `quality` preset). Standard when neither this nor `preset` is sent.

preset.description: The tier to run at, in create's preset names. Sent with `quality_tier`, both must name the same tier.

refunded.description: True when the cancel returned credits: everything the launch charged when it came before the job started or within 10 seconds after, and later only an AI Enhance charge reserved at upload.

refunded_credits.description: Credits this cancel returned; 0 when it was not refunded.

gpu_seconds_used.description: Deprecated: never counted, so it reads 0.

storage_bytes.description: Deprecated: never counted, so it reads 0.

scenes_created.description: Max scenes creatable this period. `null` means unlimited.

scenes_processed.description: Max scenes processable this period. `null` means unlimited.

post.description: Reserve one paid launch for an uploaded scene. Retry with the same body and optional Idempotency-Key to replay the saved result without another charge, processing-quota increment, or dispatch. An uncertain upstream response remains accepted until status reconciliation resolves it.

schema.description: Optional user-scoped key. Reuse this exact key and body on retries. A different key/body for the same scene, or reuse on another scene, returns 409.

400.description: `source_missing`: the scene's source file isn't in storage, e.g. the upload never finished. Nothing was charged. Upload it again (the upload URL from create lasts 24 hours; after that, create a new scene), then call `/process` again. Any other bad request is `invalid_input`.

402.description: `insufficient_credits`: your balance doesn't cover this launch. Nothing was charged. After `/process` the scene stays `uploading`: add credits and call `/process` again. After `/retrain` no new version is kept.

413.description: `payload_too_large`: the uploaded file exceeds the 5.0 GB upload limit, the same on every plan. Nothing was charged.

415.description: The request has a body that isn't sent as `Content-Type: application/json`. `curl -d` sends form encoding unless you add that header. Nothing was created, claimed or charged.

422.description: `source_unusable`: the uploaded file can't be reconstructed: it is empty, a photo upload that isn't a zip, or a zip with fewer than 5 JPEG or PNG photos (HEIC, WebP and other formats are skipped). `details` names the rule, e.g. `{ field: "photo_count", value: 3, allowed: { min: 5 } }`. Nothing was charged. Upload a usable file to the same upload URL (it lasts 24 hours from create) and call `/process` again, or create a new scene.

429.description: `queue_full`: as many of your scenes are processing as your plan allows at once. Nothing was charged, and `meta` holds `limit` and `current`. After `/process` the scene stays `uploading`: call `/process` again once one finishes. After `/retrain` no new version is kept, unless the response carries no `Retry-After`: then check `GET /v1/scenes` before sending it again. `quota_exceeded`: the monthly quota is used up; `meta` holds `period`, `limit` and `field`. After `/retrain` no new version is kept.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before starting the scene again. Sent with `queue_full` only.

post.description: Process a scene's source again as a new scene (a version), at the tier `quality_tier` or `preset` names, standard when neither is sent. `id` and `scene_id` name the new scene; the source scene is left as it is, running or not. Each request makes another version. A retrain refused before any charge keeps no new version; after a `502` the new version stays, failed and refunded.

get.description: Download the processed 3D Gaussian Splat model file.

schema.description: File to download. `sog` (default): compressed, for web viewers. `ply`: raw splat at full precision. `sog` and `ply` fall back to each other; the `X-Splat-Format` header names the file sent. `spz`: Niantic's compressed splat format, for viewers that load `.spz` files, such as native renderers. Older scenes, and scenes whose SPZ conversion failed, have none: they answer 404, never another format.

get.description: Get the PNG thumbnail for a scene. A public scene's needs no API key. A private scene's is served only to its owner's key: any other caller gets `404`, so whether a scene exists stays private. A deleted scene's is never served.

200.description: PNG thumbnail image. An old scene with no recorded thumbnail may answer its legacy JPEG; `Content-Type` names the type.

post.description: A scene finished processing. Sent as a `POST` to the scene's `webhook_url`, with `Content-Type: application/json` and `User-Agent: Splat-Webhook/1.0`. Answer any 2xx to acknowledge it. Any other status, or a network error, is retried: 3 attempts in all, 1 s then 2 s apart, with the same body and signature. Redirects are followed and the last response counts: a 301, 302 or 303 turns the `POST` into a `GET` without the body, so register the final URL. Only scenes created with a `webhook_url` send events; a retrain's new version sends none, a cancel sends none, and a launch that fails at `/process`, which answers with an error, sends none. A scene reported failed whose job then finishes sends `scene.completed` after `scene.failed`, so read `GET /v1/scenes/{id}` for the current state.

schema.description: Sent only when the scene was created with a `webhook_secret`. Format `t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex>`: `v1` is the HMAC-SHA256, keyed with your `webhook_secret`, of `<t>.<raw request body>`. To verify, compute it over the body bytes as received (not JSON you re-serialized), compare it with `v1` in constant time, and refuse a `t` older than 5 minutes, which stops replays. Retries carry the same `t`.

200.description: Any 2xx acknowledges the event. The body is ignored.

A scene reported failed whose job then finishes sends `scene.completed` after `scene.failed`, so read `GET /v1/scenes/{id}` for the current state.
